title: Debugger breakpoints and watches
description: Use breakpoints, step-through execution and watch expressions to catch an arithmetic bug, then verify the corrected invoice calculation.
objectives: Configure a debugger for an ES module in Node.js
Pause at a conditional breakpoint and inspect function state
Use a watch expression to inspect intermediate calculations
Repair a verified bug and protect the fix with regression tests
rubric: I reproduced the original failing invoice scenario.
I inspected watched values at a local breakpoint before editing.
I corrected the calculation and passed positive and negative test cases.
